phase1.description: Initial intervals of all six coupled runs: T1e8 meshes through 12 yr, T1e7 through 12 yr, T1e9 and T1e10 through 25 yr. Midpoint throughout.

featured_continuations.description: T1e8 n=16384 from 12 to 35 yr; the first n=8192 continuation was interrupted and excluded from the final outputs.

other_continuations.description: T1e7 from 12 to 48 yr and T1e9 from 25 to 80 yr. The first T1e10 continuation was interrupted and excluded from final outputs.

time_refinement.description: T1e8 n=16384, 1 yr, rtol=2.5e-5. No subsecond time steps.

notes: Initial binaries were compiled with GCC 8.5.0 -O3 and FFTW 3.3.10 built with AVX2. Archived SAT surface-pressure residuals are <=1.904 Pa; final code projects these to the exact Dirichlet condition. Final source reruns are not claimed to be bitwise identical to older-phase outputs.

resumed_continuations.description: T1e8 n=8192 was restarted at year 12 and T1e10 at year 25 after termination signals; their retained early continuations end at the switch times recorded below. This revision also extends T1e8 n=32768 from year 12 to its recorded switch. Uses exact surface-pressure projection and periodic checkpoints.

seismic_time_test.description: T1e8 n=16384, both rtol=1e-4 and 2.5e-5 from the identical phase-one checkpoint at year 12 to year 14.7.

integrator_benchmark.description: Same equations and tolerance as seismic_time_baseline; expanded fifth-order stages when hydraulic CFL < 0.2, with every stage checked against CFL < 0.4.

threaded_continuation.description: Independent depth-node friction evaluations parallelized with OpenMP; recorded seismic benchmark gives byte-identical fields, final state and step history.

threading_benchmark.description: One and eight threads, same one-second seismic continuation; fields, final state and history compared byte for byte.
